sections.section: RULES - Punjab Agriculture Department (Field Wing) Service Rules 2011
sections.description:
PUNJAB AGRICULTURE DEPARTMENT
PUNJAB AGRICULTURE
DEPARTMENT
(FIELD WING) SERVICE
RULES, 2011
[Gazette of Punjab, Part
I,
26th September, 2012]
No.SOR-III/S&GAD)1-16/2004, dated
3-11-2011.--In exercise of the powers conferred under section 23 of the Punjab
Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974),Governor of the Punjab is pleased to
make the following rules:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Punjab Agriculture (Field Wing) Service Rules,
2011.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Method of recruitment.---The method
of recruitment, minimum qualification, age limit and other incidental matters
for the posts of the Functional Unit shall be such as given in the Schedule
appended to these rules.
3. Repeal.---The
Punjab Agriculture Department (Field Wing) Service Rules, 1993 are here
repealed.
[Note:
For Schedule please see Gazette of Punjab, Part I, dated 26-11-2012, pp.461 to
533]
